initiatives.name: Movimiento Poder
initiatives.description: Denver group led by working-class Latine youth and parents. Organizes on school policy, police in schools and immigrant families' rights, and runs leadership and healing programs.

initiatives.name: Denver Communists
initiatives.description: Socialist political group in Denver, founded in 2012 as a branch of the International Socialist Organization. Runs organizing and education work and joins local mutual aid and protest actions.

initiatives.name: Cats Not Cops
initiatives.description: We host a hot dinner & mutual aid event 3 nights a week at 4pm with volunteer services available.

initiatives.name: SAME Cafe
initiatives.description: Pay-what-you-can cafe at 2023 E. Colfax Ave in Denver. Diners donate money, produce, or volunteer time for a meal, and the group runs a Cook to Work job training program.

initiatives.name: Denver Community Fridges
initiatives.description: Maintains outdoor community fridges and pantries in Denver and Aurora, open to anyone around the clock, to reduce food insecurity and food waste.

initiatives.name: Denver Black Reparations Council
initiatives.description: Nonprofit that gives reparative grants to Black-led nonprofits, businesses and community projects in Denver and Colorado, and manages the Denver Reparations Fund.

initiatives.name: Reparations Circle Denver
initiatives.description: A community of contributors working to build reparative change through direct funding and support of Black-led initiatives in Denver. They partner with the Denver Black Reparations Council to coordinate grant-making, mutual aid, and community building while fostering a culture of repair and racial healing through education, dialogue, and collective action.

initiatives.name: Liberating Library
initiatives.description: Book distribution program and online collection of radical texts run by a Pan-African socialist. It gives free books to community members, study groups and political education projects.

initiatives.name: Little Read Books
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run socialist political education collective in Denver that gives away free books and runs reading groups, film screenings, and book donations to jails and prisons.

initiatives.name: Mutual Aid Monday
initiatives.description: Mutual Aid Monday is a grassroots, mutual aid community in Denver composed of community members that care deeply for our neighbors experiencing homelessness.

initiatives.name: Rocky Mountain Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: Volunteer mutual aid food box delivery, rooted in partnership with @joyskitchen_org ✨Drivers and remote coordinators needed
